scripts.build: npm run tokens && npm run build -w @prepzy/student-web
scripts.build:production: npm run tokens && npm run build:production -w @prepzy/student-web
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
scripts.verify: npm run generate -w @prepzy/design-system -- --check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test -w @prepzy/design-system && npm run test:coverage -w @prepzy/student-web
scripts.verify:full: npm run verify && npm run e2e -w @prepzy/student-web
